blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Manila Water Foundation, the social development arm of Manila Water Company, inaugurated a Water Asset Installation and Rehabilitation project on October 15, Global Handwashing Day in Mandaluyong City. The WASH project was made possible with support from the Manila Water Makati-Mandaluyong Service Area, significantly improving water pressure and water availability for more than 4,000 learners, teachers and staff on campus every day. The milestone project was witnessed Mandaluyong City Mayor Menchie Abalos along with the DepEd Mandaluyong Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Margarito Materum. Mataas na Paaralang Neptali A.
